image_description: A close-up view of a black, box-shaped loudspeaker enclosure. The front face features a large circular driver (woofer) with a white cone and a prominent black dust cap in the center. Above the main driver, a portion of a smaller driver (tweeter/horn) is visible. There are mounting screws at the corners of the driver frame and a small sticker on the upper left.
